title: Tiger Prawns with Mediterranean Paella
description: A flavorful and vibrant seafood paella dish with tiger prawns, perfect for a dinner gathering. Serve immediately and enjoy!
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cherry tomatoes and red bell pepper, cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add the paella rice and stir to coat with the oil and mix with the vegetables.
Add the Mediterranean seasoning and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a simmer.
Add the tiger prawns and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
Reduce heat to low and cover the pan with a lid.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the zesty olives and cook for an additional minute.
